description: Searches file contents (like grep -rn) in a file or folder inside the allowed folders, e.g. core_dump. Shows matching lines as file:line:text, or only the matching files. Use find to search file names instead.

params.name: pattern
params.description: Extended regular expression to search for, e.g. print_pi or def [a-z_]+; plain text with fixed

params.name: path
params.description: File or folder to search, starting with an allowed folder name, e.g. core_dump/src; omit it to search tools

params.name: fixed
params.description: Treat the pattern as plain text, not a regular expression

params.name: files_only
params.description: List only the files that match, not the lines

params.name: context
params.description: Lines to show before and after each match, 0 to 5 (default 0)

params.name: include
params.description: Only search files whose names match this glob, e.g. *.c or *.h
